item.title: New Teams mean Tighter Grid
item.description:
The 2026 season is special because the grid is growing! For the first time in many years, we have more than 10 teams. There are also big changes for the companies that build the engines.

1. Cadillac (The 11th Team)

The biggest news for 2026 is the arrival of Cadillac. This is a famous American brand.

The Team: They are the 11th team on the grid. They are working with the Andretti family (a very famous name in racing).

item.title: F1 2026 - New Regulations Explained
item.description:
Welcome to the 2026 Formula 1 season! This year is very exciting because the cars have changed a lot. The new rules make the racing closer, the cars smaller, and the engines “greener.” Here is a simple guide to the biggest changes in F1 for 2026.

1. Smaller and Lighter Cars

In the past few years, F1 cars were very big and heavy. For 2026, the FIA (the people who make the rules) decided to make them “nimble.” This means they are easier to move and better for racing in tight spaces.
